pages.title: Welcome, Engineer!
pages.text: The art of siege warfare has been perfected over centuries. With this manual, you will learn to construct and operate the most devastating weapons of medieval warfare.$(br2)From simple mortars to mighty trebuchets, each machine serves a purpose on the battlefield.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.text: Your first step is to craft a $(item)Siege Workbench$(). This special crafting station is required to build most siege machines.$(br2)You'll also need to gather $(item)Beams$(), $(item)Wheels$(), and other components before constructing your first weapon of war.
